name.description: The unique name to which this series is mapped.

data.description:
An array of data that will be charted. Each value must be an array with three elements: [x-index, y-index, data value], where
<x-index> is the column index on the heat map and <y-index> is the row index on the heat map.

title: This type represents the series part of an eCharts config.
name: UiSdlHeatMapEChartSeries
